name: puppeteer-mcp
description: MCP server for controlling Chrome via Puppeteer

scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && rm -rf dist && node esbuild.config.js
scripts.dev: concurrently "esbuild --watch" "nodemon --watch dist --exec 'node dist/index.js && pnpm run restart-inspector' dist/index.js"
scripts.restart-inspector: pkill -f '@modelcontextprotocol/inspector' || true && sleep 1 && pnpm run inspector &

author: @ratiofu
